title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - MaterialCategory
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/MaterialCategory . Describes a category of material in terms of its static properties, e.g. a certain category of steel or plastic. Each MaterialCategory can have multiple related MaterialBatches, which represent the physical material; essential properties of the material related to a MaterialCategory are similar across its batches, though small deviations might occur.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MaterialCategory'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isCategoryOf.description: Relationship. The material batches that belong to this material category (inverse of MaterialBatch's belongsToCategory). Target model: 'MaterialBatch'.
